body:
## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Extensive raw Tailwind classes found.

## FINDINGS
`UXAuditor.tsx` still contains numerous raw Tailwind classes (`text-sm`, `w-64`, `bg-slate-900`, `shadow-[...]`, etc.), violating the project's strict design token guidelines and primitive-based layout requirements. The PR also bundles unrelated changes like the massive deletion in `plan.md`.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: Violates Rule #1 (Token compliance): `className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-bg border-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent outline-none w-64 text-sm font-mono text-text"` - avoid raw padding, flex/grid utility layout, and arbitrary text sizing unless mapped directly through primitives or `tokens.css`.

Violates Rule #1 (Token compliance): `className="flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 shadow-lg text-sm transition-all disabled:opacity-50"` - do not use hardcoded colors (`bg-slate-900`) and arbitrary shadow definitions.

Violates Rule #1 (No arbitrary Tailwind): `<div className={\`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${imp.severity > 7 ? 'bg-red-500 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(239,68,68,0.4)]' : 'bg-amber-500'}\`} />` - arbitrary values like `shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(...)]` and hardcoded `bg-red-500` are banned.
